name: AgentBeatVideo
description: Create local beat-synchronized music videos with Chinese titles.
description_zh: 将授权目录内的图片、视频、音乐和中文文案剪辑为竖屏卡点短片。
description_en: Create local beat-synchronized videos from your media and Chinese copy.
examples_zh: 扫描已授权的素材文件夹，分析 tide.wav 的节拍。
规划一条 20 秒的竖屏短片，渲染后给我 MP4 路径和质量报告。
examples_en: Scan my authorized media folder and analyze tide.wav.
Render a 20-second vertical film and return the quality report.
